title: Unique Repair Services
description: Unique Repair Services specializes in fast and reliable appliance repair and maintenance in Des Plaines, IL, and surrounding areas. They offer a wide range of services including repairs for refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, and HVAC systems, with a focus on customer satisfaction and same-day service. The company employs factory-authorized technicians trained in major brands like Samsung, Electrolux, and Frigidaire, ensuring high-quality repairs backed by a 90-day guarantee. Their intended clients are homeowners seeking dependable and professional appliance repair solutions.
